intro.h2: Countertops cut in Jesup, installed by the people who cut them
paragraphs: Solid Surfaces is a countertop store and fabricator for granite countertops in Jesup, doing kitchens and bathrooms for homeowners who are remodeling or building new. Granite and quartz are cut in the company's own fabrication facility, then installed by its own crew.

Ask their customers what stands out and you hear about people. Reviewers name Nelson, who made sure one homeowner was completely satisfied with the whole process, and Terry, the installer. One customer says the team has done two dozen homes for him, each one better than the last. Others mention lots of stone to choose from and excellent pricing.

services.h2: Granite countertops in Jesup, plus quartz and more

items.name: Granite countertops
items.blurb: Granite is cut in the Solid Surfaces fabrication shop in Jesup. A stock granite list posted on their Facebook page has included Omicron Silver, Blue Nile, Sienna Beige, Fantasy Brown, White Ice and Dallas White, so ask what is in stock today.

image.alt: Gray and white veined stone countertop with matching backsplash on white shaker base cabinets

items.name: Quartz countertops
items.blurb: Quartz is the other half of their fabrication work. Many of the finished kitchens in their review photos use bright white quartz-look tops with soft gray veining, paired with white, gray or stained cabinets and undermount stainless sinks.

image.alt: White countertop with gray veining on a large island with an undermount stainless sink and gray cabinets

items.name: Choosing your slab
items.blurb: Reviewers say there are lots to choose from. Ask to see the slabs and look at the full pattern before you decide, from quiet whites to dramatic blue and taupe veining. Customers describe the staff as courteous and helpful while they choose.

image.alt: Close view of a natural stone slab with blue and taupe veining

items.name: Islands and statement pieces
items.blurb: Big islands are where stone shows best. Solid Surfaces has posted an island finished in Shadow Storm marble and a customer's waterfall island, where the countertop runs down the sides to the floor. Bring your island plan and talk through the options.

image.alt: Long kitchen island with a polished white countertop and bold gray veining

items.name: Bathroom vanity tops
items.blurb: Bathrooms get the same stone and the same install crew. Solid Surfaces has shared projects with kitchens and bathrooms done in granite, and their photos include undermount sinks set into white countertops with clean cut edges.

image.alt: Close-up of a white undermount sink set into a white veined countertop with a faucet hole

items.name: Countertops for new homes
items.blurb: Building a house? One reviewer said choosing Solid Surfaces was the best decision of her whole new-home build. Another customer says they have done two dozen homes for him, each more perfect than the last. They handle remodels too, from one kitchen to a whole house.

image.alt: New-construction kitchen with a white veined island top, gray cabinets and a dishwasher still in blue protective film

why_choose_us.h2: Why Jesup customers get their stone here

items.title: Their own fabrication shop
items.text: Solid Surfaces runs its own granite and quartz fabrication facility, so your countertops are cut by the same company whose crew installs them, with no outside shop in between.

items.title: An installer reviewers name
items.text: Reviewers call the installation crew extremely professional and meticulous, and one names Terry as an awesome installer. Every one of the 8 Google reviews is five stars.

items.title: Nelson stays involved
items.text: Customers mention Nelson by name. One said he made sure she was completely satisfied with the entire process, and a repeat customer called him an outstanding businessman and incredibly talented at his job.

items.title: Choice and fair prices
items.text: Reviewers describe lots to choose from with excellent pricing and great prices. That matters on a whole kitchen, and even more when you are doing several rooms or several homes.

about.text: Solid Surfaces, Inc. is a countertop store and fabricator on Odum Hwy in Jesup, Georgia. The company cuts granite and quartz in its own fabrication facility and installs with its own crew, for homeowners who are remodeling or building new. Customers know Nelson, who one reviewer says made sure she was completely satisfied with the entire process, and Terry, who installs. The work ranges from a single bathroom vanity to two dozen homes for one customer, and the reviews read the same either way: helpful, courteous people and beautiful countertops.
about.owner_role: Named in reviews as the person who runs customer jobs ('outstanding businessman'); full name and title not published. Terry is named as installer.

image.alt: White kitchen with a white countertop island, undermount sink, gold faucet and pendant lights

steps.title: Call or stop by
steps.text: Call (912) 530-8595 or visit the Odum Hwy location on a weekday. Note they close for lunch from noon to 1 PM.

steps.title: Choose your stone
steps.text: Look through granite, quartz and other stones. Reviewers say there is lots to choose from, and the staff are courteous and helpful.

steps.title: Fabrication
steps.text: Your countertops are cut and finished in the Solid Surfaces granite and quartz fabrication facility, not sent out to another shop.

steps.title: Installation
steps.text: Their own installation crew sets the countertops. Reviewers describe the crew as extremely professional and meticulous.

steps.title: Make sure you are satisfied
steps.text: One customer said Nelson made sure she was completely satisfied with the entire process. Walk through the finished tops and raise any questions.

service_area.text: Solid Surfaces works from 1909 Odum Hwy in Jesup, GA 31546. Jesup is the town on its Google profile and the town tagged on its Facebook project posts. Homeowners who are remodeling or building a new home in and around Jesup can call (912) 530-8595 to ask about installation at their address and to talk through their kitchen or bath.

items.q: Do you fabricate the countertops yourselves?
items.a: Yes. Solid Surfaces has its own granite and quartz fabrication facility. Your countertops are cut and finished there, then installed by the company's own crew. Reviewers describe that crew as extremely professional and meticulous, and one names Terry as an awesome installer.

items.q: What stones can I choose from?
items.a: Granite and quartz are their core materials, and they have also posted an island done in Shadow Storm marble. A stock granite list on their Facebook page has included Omicron Silver, Blue Nile, Sienna Beige, Fantasy Brown, White Ice and Dallas White. Stock changes, so call to ask what is available now.

items.q: Do you do countertops for new homes?
items.a: Yes. One customer wrote on Google that the team has done two dozen homes for him, each one more perfect than the last. A homeowner building a new house said choosing Solid Surfaces was the best decision of her build. They also do countertops for remodels.

Google lists Monday to Thursday from 8 AM to 12 PM and 1 PM to 5 PM, and Friday from 8 AM to 12 PM and 1 PM to 4 PM. They are closed Saturday and Sunday and close for lunch from noon to 1 PM on weekdays.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Call (912) 530-8595 or email solidsurfaces@bellsouth.net with your cabinet layout or measurements and the stone you like. Price depends on the material and the size of the job. Reviewers mention excellent pricing and great prices, and the team can walk you through your options.
